changelog:
Controls are easier to hit, the player says what its buttons do, and a film's page looks the way it was designed.

WHAT CHANGED

- Every button and tappable line in the app now has a touch area at least the size of a fingertip, including the player's controls, "Try again", and the schedule's rows.
- With TalkBack on, the player's controls say what they do ("Play or pause", "Back 10 seconds", "Audio track") instead of reading out symbols. Posters also say how far into a film you are.
- A film's page shows "Resume" with the time it will start from, when you have watched part of it.
- A film's page has a larger title, a rounded Play button, and a round Favorite button. Rating and quality now show as small badges.
- When a film has no background image, its page uses a soft glow in the poster's main colour instead of a blurred copy of the poster.
- In a channel's schedule, the programme on now says how long it has left, and each programme sits on its own card.

WHAT STAYS THE SAME

- Everything else, including your sources, favourites, settings and guide.

NOT YET

- The guide's storage still grows a little with every refresh, and the Continue Watching and What's On Now rows are still to come.
